name: Lysatra
description: Lysatra was an isolated planet in the Lysatra system in grid square I-8 of the Standard Galactic Grid, a portion of the Expansion Region that was considered Wild Space. By 15 BBY, it was still considered a part of Wild Space. Eli Vanto grew up on Lysatra, where he heard stories about the Chiss and worked in a shipping company. Besides Galactic Basic Standard, many trade languages of the Wild Space were spoken, including the language Sy Bisti.
